_targets.work list row 2: **FOUND, 15 September 2026.** Ahnentafel 54's marriage is on folio 4 (image 231), «Anno Domini 1807», seventh entry: «…habito mutuo consensu **Georgii filij defti Georgii Uroda** et **Maria filia Michaelis Gergas** hujatium, eos solemniter in facie Ecclesiae Matrimonio conjunxit idem praemissa, praesentibus testibus **Caspare Jerko viduo** et **Joanne Fero…**». Date column 17; the month column is a ditto for the entry above it (16 Junii), so **17 June 1807**. Folio 6 (image 232) was read end to end — 1809 and 1810 to the «Finis» — and holds no Uroda at all.

_umrli_1774_1804._kazalo: The volume's own A-Z index sits at images ~410-434. Image 427: LEFT page Q (sparse), RIGHT page P — three dense columns. Image 428: LEFT page P continued (folios 104-106 only, seven entries), RIGHT page R. Entries within a letter run BY FOLIO, not alphabetically, so a surname is found by scanning the letter's columns.
_umrli_1774_1804._why_the_kazalo: The FamilySearch record index holds baptisms only for Karlobag (row 43), so this book must be walked — but its own index turns a walk into two page loads.
